name: Neon
subtitle: Serverless Postgres
creator: Nikita Shamgunov, Heikki Linnakangas and Stas Kelvich
description: Real PostgreSQL that separates storage from compute, so databases scale to zero when idle and wake on demand. It can branch a database like Git branches code, and its HTTP driver works from serverless and edge functions.
useCases: Side projects that idle a lot
AI agents that spin up databases

concepts.explanation: Instant copies of your database for testing.
Billing based on CPU and memory used.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript · serverless driver

cons: Cold starts of a few hundred milliseconds after idle

pricing.summary: Free plan (0.5 GB storage, 100 compute-hours). Launch plan is usage-based with no monthly minimum. Also sold through the Vercel and Netlify marketplaces.
